name: growing-pai-mcp-teamleader
description: MCP server for Teamleader Focus CRM — manage contacts, companies, deals, tasks, events, invoices, quotations, projects and time tracking.
long_description: Connects Claude to Teamleader Focus CRM. Each installer supplies their own Teamleader OAuth credentials (client ID, client secret, refresh token) — no credentials are bundled in this extension. Optionally unlock deals, invoices and quotations by setting an admin passphrase, and override financial defaults (ledger account, product category) used when creating invoices.

teamleader_client_id.title: Teamleader Client ID
teamleader_client_id.description: REQUIRED. OAuth2 client ID for your own Teamleader Focus app.

teamleader_client_secret.title: Teamleader Client Secret
teamleader_client_secret.description: REQUIRED. OAuth2 client secret for your own Teamleader Focus app.

teamleader_refresh_token.title: Teamleader Refresh Token
teamleader_refresh_token.description: REQUIRED. OAuth2 refresh token for your own Teamleader Focus account. Generate one with the scripts/get-refresh-token.mjs helper in the source repo, or via your own OAuth flow.

admin_passphrase.title: Admin Passphrase (optional)
admin_passphrase.description: OPTIONAL. Unlocks financially sensitive tools — deals, invoices and quotations. Leave blank to hide those tools entirely for this session.

default_ledger_account.title: Default Ledger Account (optional)
default_ledger_account.description: OPTIONAL. Default ledger/rekening account number used when creating invoices. Falls back to 700000 if left blank.

default_product_category_id.title: Default Product Category ID (optional)
default_product_category_id.description: OPTIONAL. Teamleader product category ID used as a default when none is specified.
